description: Allowed parent/child rules from research section 3 (allowed parent/child matrix). scripts/structure.mjs derives each component's parents from these rules and its children as the inverse, so the two always agree. Page-level regions (group A) sit in the page template, overlays render in the top layer, and inline items go wherever their host allows; none of those get parents.

slot.note: Slot count = Grid preset. No layout blocks inside.

hero.note: Max one per page, first in main.
